resources.string: Add the widget to your home screen, then drag its edges to resize it. The text fits automatically and wraps on smaller widgets.
Allow alarms and reminders so the clock can update each minute. Updates may pause while your phone sleeps or saves battery.
To add the widget, touch and hold your home screen and choose Widgets, then nederlandse tijd.
Open Settings, find this app, and allow Alarms & reminders.
The time in Dutch words on a single row
No clock app is available on this device.
